description: Stadt Duisburg: Überschwemmungsgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Areas that may be affected by floods, taking into account existing flood protection facilities. Different data sets depending on: 1. Calculation method / historical source 2. Design flooding (Rhine) (Source: State Environment Agency of North Rhine-Westphalia). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Duisburg: Flooding areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hochwasser, Wasser, Überschwemmung, Umwelt, Hochwasserschutz. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
